_metadata.description: When an adoption record goes behind, file a `fix` backlog item via swarm-manager's CLI.

requirements.title: Drift transitions trigger a single issue per adoption record
requirements.description: On refresh, when an adoption record's status transitions from current to behind/modified, the service invokes `swarm-manager backlog create --data ...` (kind=`fix`, tags include `react-component-library` and `drift`) to file a backlog item in swarm-manager. The created item's `<kind>/<name>` is recorded on the adoption record (`drift_backlog_ref`) to suppress duplicates on subsequent refreshes.

validation.notes: drift_reporter_test.go: 3 service tests (TestService_Refresh_FilesDriftBacklogOnce, ...ClearsRefOnReturnToCurrent, ...ReporterErrorDoesNotFailRefresh) + 3 SwarmManagerCLIReporter unit tests (shapes args/parses response, propagates CLI error, rejects malformed response). All 6 verified passing 2026-07-14.

requirements.title: Integration uses the scenario CLI, never raw HTTP
requirements.description: If swarm-manager's CLI lacks a verb needed for this integration, the verb must be added to that CLI first. The library never falls back to direct HTTP calls.

validation.notes: The reporter test verifies the integration shapes a `swarm-manager backlog create --data ...` CLI invocation and parses the CLI response; the adoption package has no raw HTTP reporter path (grep for net/http in internal/adoptions non-test code returns nothing). Verified passing 2026-07-14.
